# splunkctl tags

CIM/eventtype tag assignments (tags.conf) — read-only.

## tags get

Show a tags.conf stanza's tag keys and their enabled/disabled state.

```text
splunkctl tags get [OPTIONS] FIELD_VALUE
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | App to resolve the stanza in, when the same field=value exists in more than one app (default: current namespace). |

## tags list

List tags.conf stanzas with their enabled tag names.

```text
splunkctl tags list [OPTIONS]
```

```text
One row per ``field=value`` stanza; only enabled tags are shown —
use ``tags get`` for a stanza's full enabled/disabled breakdown.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Only tag stanzas in this app (default: current namespace, which may miss app-private stanzas — pass --app to see them all). |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |
